question.text: How will the Agit Kabayel vs. Nelson Hysa fight end on November 28, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the way the boxing match ends between Agit Kabayel and Nelson Hysa, currently scheduled for Saturday, November 28, 2026. Please note that "other outcome" includes any other outcome, including a Hysa victory, a draw, or the boxing match for any reason not being held before November 29, 2026 (local time).

research:
I found no prediction market or sportsbook line on how or in which round the fight ends. The bout is still on as of today. Kabayel is about a 95% favourite to win and most experts expect him to stop Hysa, but none of the sources settle the question.

## 1. Resolution source
- No official results page is named. The result would come from the official decision, reported by the WBC, the promoter Queensberry or the broadcaster DAZN, with BoxRec as a likely backup.
- I couldn't open the DAZN background article (it returned 403). Its link says "IBF defence", but every other source says it is the **WBC** heavyweight title. Filip Hrgovic holds the IBF belt. [DAZN](https://www.dazn.com/en-US/news/boxing/agit-kabayel-sets-first-ibf-defence-nelson-hysa-dusseldorf/m3q2qk73qx1b1s8ns5zb9g4iy), [WBC](https://wbcboxing.com/en/agit-kabayel-to-defend-wbc-world-heavyweight-title-against-nelson-hysa/)
- The fight is scheduled for 12 rounds. [Champinon](https://champinon.info/schedule/kabayel-vs-hysa/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The fight is still on for 2026-11-28 at the Merkur Spiel-Arena in Düsseldorf, live on DAZN. The WBC's own announcement names the "ESPRIT Arena", which is the stadium's old name. [Queensberry](https://queensberry.co.uk/blogs/queensberry-promotions-blog/kabayel-v-hysa-booked-for-world-title-showdown-in-dusseldorf-live-on-dazn)
- Records: Kabayel is 27-0 with 19 KOs and is 34. Hysa is 25-0 with 23 KOs and is 42. Hysa turned pro in 2022, is unranked by the WBC (No. 5 with the WBA) and has never fought anyone near Kabayel's level. [Heavyweight Boxing](https://www.heavyweightboxing.com/post/agit-kabayel-nelson-hysa-wbc-title-fight-dusseldorf), [BoxingScene](https://www.boxingscene.com/articles/agit-kabayel-nelson-hysa-confirmed-for-dusseldorf-on-november-28)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-28: Henry Maske will work the fight for DAZN as a pundit. Bild reports more than 40,000 tickets sold. [Bild](https://www.bild.de/sport/mehr-sport/boxen-tv-hammer-um-henry-maske-enthuellt-6ae2041221fd087fed7ed7e9)
- 2026-10-28: The bout is promoted as part of German boxing's "biggest weekend" (Nov 27-28). [SI](https://www.si.com/fannation/boxing/german-boxing-s-biggest-weekend-begins-with-two-european-heavyweight-title-fights)
- Undated (October): DAZN Germany ran a piece in which Kabayel's coach says the plan is not to get into a brawl ("keine Schlägerei"). I couldn't open it (403). [DAZN DE](https://www.dazn.com/de-DE/news/boxen/keine-schlaegerei-machen-agit-kabayel-coach-erklaert-plan-bei-wm-fight-gegen-hysa/1bup6hg4bcmg91j9d4du93gd9c)

- One low-quality site claims Hysa once pulled out of a planned Kabayel fight. ## 4. Base rates
- Kabayel has stopped 19 of 27 opponents (70%). His last four fights all ended early:
  - Makhmudov, round 4 (Dec 2023)
  - Sánchez, round 7 (May 2024)
  - Zhang, round 6, after Kabayel was knocked down himself (Feb 2025)
  - Knyba, round 3 (Jan 2026) [Heavyweight Boxing](https://www.heavyweightboxing.com/post/agit-kabayel-nelson-hysa-wbc-title-fight-dusseldorf)
- Those four stoppages split as one in rounds 1-3, two in rounds 4-6 and one in rounds 7-12. His early-career wins on points include Dereck Chisora (2017), which is from memory and not checked here.
- Kabayel has boxed about 134 pro rounds to Hysa's 68. Hysa has stopped 92% of his opponents. [Box.live, via search snippet](https://box.live/fights/kabayel-vs-hysa/)
- Generally, heavyweight title fights between a heavy favourite and a challenger who hasn't been tested tend to end inside the distance. Late cancellations happen in a small share of fights (a few percent).

## 5. Other forecasts
- Moneyline (dates not shown, so they may be stale):
  - FanDuel: Kabayel -1800, Hysa +900 [FanDuel](https://sportsbook.fanduel.com/boxing/boxing-matches/agit-kabayel-v-nelson-hysa-36140224)

  - Box.live: Kabayel 1/20, Hysa 9/1 [Box.live](https://box.live/fights/kabayel-vs-hysa/)
  - Together these put Hysa's chance at roughly 5-10% after removing the bookmaker margin.
- I found no lines on method of victory or round bands.
- Box.live's poll of 8 users: Kabayel by KO 62.5%, Hysa by KO 25%, Kabayel by decision 12.5%. Tapology community picks lean heavily to a Kabayel KO/TKO. Split-Decision picks Kabayel by KO/TKO. [Split-Decision](https://split-decision.co.uk/boxing-news/kabayel-vs-hysa/)
- Kalshi's market on who holds the WBC title on Jan 1, 2027 has Kabayel at 0.82. It is only loosely related, and its prices look inconsistent (Itauma at 0.79, Fury at 0.30). There is no Polymarket or Manifold market on this fight.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late November: final press conference and weigh-in, the main window for a late withdrawal or injury. Given the earlier money dispute and the possible earlier cancellation, that risk is worth watching.
- 2026-11-28: the fight itself, which could be stopped, end in a technical decision or a no-contest.
- Other heavyweight fights (Fury vs Joshua in December, Dubois vs Wardley rematch in late October) shouldn't change the outcome, beyond possible talk of who Kabayel fights next.

# Kabayel vs. Hysa (WBC heavyweight title, November 28, 2026): research notes

**Bottom line:** As of October 29 the fight is still on. Kabayel is about a 95% favourite on the moneyline. His last six fights all ended by stoppage, at rounds 1, 3, 3, 4, 6 and 7. I could not find any odds on the method or round of victory.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no specific source. The result will most likely be taken from the official result as reported by DAZN, the WBC, BoxRec or Wikipedia. The background link to the DAZN article returned a 403 error, so I could not read it.
- 2026-10-02: Frank Warren confirmed the bout for November 28 in Düsseldorf. It is Kabayel's first WBC title defence. [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/boxing/2026/10/02/boxing-wbc-heavyweight-champion-kabayel039s-first-defence-confirmed-for-duesseldorf-on-november-28)
- The WBC's own release confirms it is a WBC title defence. It names the venue as the "ESPRIT Arena", which is an older name for the Merkur Spiel-Arena. [WBC](https://wbcboxing.com/en/agit-kabayel-to-defend-wbc-world-heavyweight-title-against-nelson-hysa/)
- Note: the background headline says "IBF". That looks like an error, because Filip Hrgovic holds the IBF belt. [Punch](https://punchng.com/hrgovic-sets-conditions-for-second-itauma-clash/)

## 2. Current status
- The fight has not happened and nothing settles the question yet. No postponement or injury had been reported as of October 28.

- Risk to keep in mind: an earlier Kabayel vs. Hysa booking fell apart. Kabayel fought Damian Knyba instead on January 10, 2026. **Hysa** is 25-0 with 23 KOs and is 42 years old (some sources say 41).

forecasts.reasoning:
**(a) Time left:** About 30 days. The fight is on 2026-11-28 in Düsseldorf, and the result will be known that night.

**(b) Status quo:** The fight goes ahead and Kabayel, a 27-0 WBC champion priced around -1800 to -2000, beats a 42-year-old untested challenger. His recent pattern points to a mid-round stoppage.

**(c) Base rates:**
- Kabayel has stopped about 70% of his opponents.
- His last four fights all ended early: rounds 3, 4, 6 and 7. That is one stoppage in rounds 1-3, two in rounds 4-6 and one in rounds 7-12.
- He tends to start methodically and break opponents down with body work. That favours the middle rounds over a fast blowout, though against weaker opposition (Knyba) he finished in round 3.
- Heavy favourites against untested challengers in heavyweight title fights usually win inside the distance.
- Late cancellations happen in a few percent of fights.

**(d) Strongest evidence:**
- Bookmaker moneylines (dates unknown) put Hysa at roughly 5-10% after removing the margin.
- On 2026-10-13, Bernd Boente predicted Kabayel wins inside five rounds but warned about Hysa's counter right hand.
- In October, Kabayel's coach said the plan is "keine Schlägerei" (no brawl), which suggests a patient, technical approach. That lowers the chance of an early finish and raises the chance of a decision a little.
- Hysa is 42, has stopped 92% of his opponents and has never been tested at this level. He is fragile in the sense of being unproven, but his punching power keeps an upset possible.
- The pairing may have fallen through once before (Tapology shows an earlier booking that became Kabayel vs. Knyba), and there was a money dispute this time. Both add some cancellation risk.

**(e) Unexpected scenario:** Kabayel walks onto Hysa's counter right in the early rounds and is stopped, as he was hurt against Zhang. Or Hysa withdraws during fight week and the bout is not held before November 29. Either one resolves as "Other outcome."

**Estimate:**
- Kabayel wins about 88% of the time, about 7% Hysa wins and about 5% covers cancellation, a draw or a no-contest.
- Given a Kabayel win, I put a stoppage at about 78%. The stoppages lean to rounds 4-6 because of his pace and the cautious game plan.
- There is a meaningful chance of a decision because Kabayel is patient and Hysa is a 42-year-old with the durability of an unknown.
- There is no market on method or round, so this is my own estimate built from the moneyline and the base rates above.
